cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: A barge of geese, two hundred by the manifest, is in the chamber when the crate slats give. The chamber is full of geese. The bargee is full of opinions.

left.label: Close the gates and catch them
left.outcome: An hour of hands, feathers and language. Most are caught.

right.label: Open the top gate and let them go
right.outcome: Two hundred geese enter the Summit Pound. The bargee enters the Book, as a complaint.

cards.speaker: ilse
cards.text: There are geese in my yard, geese on my roof and a goose in my cellar that has opinions about the ale. Whose geese, Keeper, and what does it cost?

left.label: The Company's geese now
left.outcome: "Then the Company owes me a cellar."

right.label: The bargee's problem
right.outcome: "He left this morning. The geese did not."

cards.speaker: dace
cards.text: Three things. The hands want a goose each for the trouble. The chapel wants them for the poor. And there's one in the paddle gear that we can't get at.

left.label: A goose each for the hands
left.outcome: Feathers everywhere for a week. Morale improves.

right.label: The chapel feeds the town
right.outcome: Hale blesses the geese, then cooks them. Dace sulks.

cards.speaker: src_stranger
cards.text: A drover arrives on foot from Aldmere with a bill of sale for two hundred geese and a very reasonable question about where they are.

left.label: Pay him from the Coffers
left.outcome: He counts it twice and asks about the one in the paddles.

right.label: Send him to the Company
right.outcome: Pell will write him a magnificent letter.

cards.speaker: ilse
cards.text: The goose in my cellar has laid. In the ale trough. The town has named her. I am not going to tell you the name. Do you want her moved or not?

left.label: Move her to the chapel
left.outcome: Hale accepts a goose with grace. The town visits.

right.label: She stays; she's the town's now
right.outcome: "Her name is Pell." She said she wouldn't tell you.

cards.speaker: src_ledger
cards.text: Weeks on, geese still turn up: in the chamber, on the chapel roof, once in Vosk's document case. The town has begun to count them as weather.

left.label: Declare the matter closed
left.outcome: The Book says closed. The geese did not read it.

right.label: Bounty: a mark a goose
right.outcome: Children become rich. Wren, somehow, becomes richer.
